'''Smugglers' Strip''' was an illegal landing field on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]] that was constructed by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Lud Chud]]. It was a small, isolated landing station deep in one of the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] valleys located about 1,500 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] northeast of [[Elrooden]].

==Description==
The Smugglers' Strip facility itself was a simple level patch of ground with several [[Bi-state memory plastic]] "temporary" shelters on the mountainside which could be confused for a homestead or small [[Farm/Legends|farm]] from a distance. Instead, below ground level, there were vast underground storehouses for keeping contraband weapons, [[Spice/Legends|spice]], medicines and any other materials that were smuggled onto [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]], many to simply avoid the high tariffs. The area around the facility had carefully placed [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] [[baffle]]rs to disguise the presence of the underground [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] and any trace emissions left from the comings and goings of [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The field itself always had half a dozen mob musclemen, and usually a more "refined" representative of the mob, who provided payment and otherwise ensured that deals were completed. [[Landspeeder/Legends|Landspeeders]] were available to bring cargo into the [[City/Legends|cities]], where it was sold on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]].

Only a few ships per [[Standard month/Legends|month]] were allowed to land at Smugglers' Strip in order to avoid tipping off the Elrooden authorities. As a result, black market prices were five times higher than standard cost. A ship could be unloaded of contraband, be refueled and be back on its flight plan within the span of a few [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]]. With careful high speed flying, a ship could arrive at a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on schedule so that the automated flight system or flight controllers had no idea that the ship even stopped.
